items.title: Shivon Zilis posts Elon Musk's texts after their breakup
items.summary: Hours after Musk was spotted unfollowing her, Shivon Zilis, the mother of four of his children, said he had ended their relationship and posted a screenshot of their texts. She later deleted the post.
items.author: @shivon

post.name: Shivon Zilis
post.text:
It’s hard to go from in love to let go in a week with no warning, but that’s just how it is sometimes 🤷🏻‍♀️
